elements.element: Transition assistance provided on expiry or termination of the Agreement
elements.evidence: "Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Array shall (a) ... provide reasonable transition assistance"
"(b) return all Data and other Confidential Information of Ono (\"Customer Data\")"

elements.element: Return in a standard machine-readable format
Return within 30 days (measured from expiry/termination, not a later request)
Deletion of Customer Data after return
elements.evidence: "(c) thereafter delete such Customer Data from its systems"
"transition assistance for up to six (6) months" (exceeds 90 days)
"in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiry or termination"

reasons: The inserted sub-paragraph (x) supplies every atomic element of the preferred position: 6-month assistance at then-current rates, 30-day return of Ono Data in standard machine-readable format measured from expiry or termination, and deletion plus written certification thereafter.

The "at Ono's request" condition attaches only to the assistance obligation; the data return, deletion and certification duties are unconditional, so the request condition does not swallow the mandatory return.
Minimality is satisfied: no operative clause existed running in our favour, and the fix is a single concise reciprocal sub-paragraph rather than a rewrite of the existing Article XIV exit mechanics.

Intent is preserved: existing paragraphs (iii), (iv), (vi) and (ix) are untouched, and "Customer Data" is defined inline within the new sentence so no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced.
Note only: "reasonable" softens the assistance standard slightly, but this is a minor sub-element and does not defeat the preferred level.
